scope: G3-2e-C with 13 bounded author decisions incorporated; other 29 still pending

records.name: assertionAboutProduct
records.question: آیا aboutness ادعا به Product فقط با ارجاع صریح ثبت شود یا از Presentation نیز انتقال یابد؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: A claim explicitly identifies a Product.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A claim about a Presentation alone cannot be promoted to Product scope.

records.name: authorizationJurisdiction
records.question: چه شاهدی صلاحیت قانونی این Authorization در Jurisdiction را ثابت می‌کند، نه محل فیزیکی مرجع را؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain contextual reference; collect legal-scope evidence; no Relator→rigid Mediation
records.evidence_to_collect: Evidence for legal applicability, validity interval and whether the scope is constitutive/immutable; decide formal stereotype only with a quality-comparison derivation or use a documented non-stereotyped reference.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A source-country field alone, or an authority office's physical address, cannot establish the authorization's legal jurisdiction.

records.name: baViewRepresents
records.question: دامنهٔ موضوعات BA View چه خانواده‌هایی را در بر می‌گیرد و آیا پیوندهای نوع‌دار لازم‌اند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Define a documented target family or qualified topic links if cross-family query need is approved.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not infer that a view target acquires a new identity or that core depends on the optional BA module.

records.name: capabilityBearer
records.question: آیا Mode باید از bearer به شکل inverse Characterization نمایش یابد و آیا هر Organization قابلیت دارد؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Preserve Mode→bearer source property; if formal Characterization required, add evidence-backed inverse bearer→Mode with one bearer per Mode.
records.evidence_to_collect: Capability is a Mode inhering in an Organization; source direction Mode→bearer reverses Characterization.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: One intrinsic Mode cannot inhere in two distinct Organizations.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep EnterpriseCapability as a Mode dependent on exactly one Organization. Preserve the current Mode-to-bearer property and add a bearer-to-Mode Characterization only after confirming inverse semantics; do not require every Organization to have a capability.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: capacityBearer
records.question: آیا SupplyCapacity به Organization یا Facility می‌چسبد و برای هر Mode دقیقاً یک bearer کدام است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Choose Organization/Facility-specific bearer routes with single-bearer invariant; do not equate observation result to Mode.
records.evidence_to_collect: Choose explicit inverse bearer→Mode characterization or scoped bearer roles; justify minimum/maximum and optional possession.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not infer capacity from an aggregate observation or assign the same intrinsic Mode to two different bearer individuals.
records.approved_decision_en: Use typed Organization and Facility bearer routes beneath a common query surface; each SupplyCapacity Mode has exactly one of these bearers. Keep SupplyCapacityObservationResult separate.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: containsSourceRecord
records.question: عضویت SourceRecord در یک DatasetRelease با کدام manifest/version اثبات می‌شود؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Release manifest/provenance assigns a SourceRecord to DatasetRelease.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Occurrence in a different release is not membership here.

records.name: contextClassificationEntry
records.question: آیا همهٔ Contextual Assignmentها باید child edge entry داشته باشند یا والد generic کافی است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Keep native child Mediation; verify optional child and parent-only cases in formal integration; no child min1.
records.evidence_to_collect: ContextualMedicineClassificationAssignment specifies an AppliedClassificationEntryRole under a list/scheme/version/jurisdiction context.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A generic classificationEntry(r,e) alone does not entail contextClassificationEntry(r,e); same lexical classification code is insufficient.
records.candidate_change_authorized: Only bounded engineering candidate; no promotion

records.name: contextClassificationJurisdiction
records.question: Jurisdiction در Assignment مرجع دامنه است یا نقش ضدصلب با شرط وجودی؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Keep legal-scope reference; do not stereotype Mediation to rigid Jurisdiction without justified anti-rigid role.
records.evidence_to_collect: A specific Assignment references legal jurisdictional scope.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Classification in J1 does not transfer to J2.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep RegulatoryJurisdiction as a formal legal-scope reference of the contextual assignment. Do not type direct Relator-to-rigid-Kind Mediation; introduce a role only if dependence is evidenced.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: contextClassificationProduct
records.question: آیا طبقه‌بندی Substance بدون child edge Product همچنان مجاز است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Keep native child Mediation; test valid Substance classification without Product child; no child min1.
records.evidence_to_collect: ContextualMedicineClassificationAssignment relates a ClassifiedMedicinalProductRole when the classified entity is specifically a Product.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A contextual assignment with a PharmaceuticalSubstance subject is valid in inherited contract and must not be forced to have a Product child edge.
records.candidate_change_authorized: Only bounded engineering candidate; no promotion

records.name: disruptionAffects
records.question: تأثیر Disruption روی کدام خانوادهٔ target با شواهد علی/زمانی ثابت می‌شود؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Specify admitted target families and causal evidence before general OWL range or stereotype.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A co-reported shortage alone cannot establish a causal disruption or its target.

records.name: disruptionAffectsDependency
records.question: آیا child edge فقط وقتی ایجاد می‌شود که تأثیر بر SupplyDependency مستقل ثبت شده باشد؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain child untyped until parent truthmaker and target family are justified
records.evidence_to_collect: Define what 'affects' means, causal-evidence standard, temporal order, parent disruptionAffects semantics, and allowed endpoint types.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Temporal overlap between a disruption and a dependency, or a co-reported shortage, does not prove D affected S.

records.name: entryInScheme
records.question: آیا هویت ClassificationEntry در یک Scheme و version وابسته است و cardinality آن چیست؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Use scheme/version reference, not functional component parthood; settle entry identity and required scheme.
records.evidence_to_collect: Scheme/version defines a ClassificationEntry.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Equal code strings across schemes do not identify one entry.
records.approved_decision_en: Retain a typed scheme-and-version reference. Do not merge equal lexical codes across schemes or impose an exactly-one-scheme axiom until the entry identity criterion is agreed.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: evidenceRecord
records.question: آیا EvidenceSupport با ObservationResult باید بدون child edge SourceRecord مجاز بماند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Keep native child Mediation; test ObservationResult evidence without SourceRecord child; no child min1.
records.evidence_to_collect: EvidenceSupport mediates a SourceRecord that bears EvidenceSourceRecordRole and an Assertion through its separate claim mediation.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An EvidenceSupport whose evidence is an ObservationResult remains valid; the parent evidenceItem edge does not entail evidenceRecord.
records.candidate_change_authorized: Only bounded engineering candidate; no promotion

records.name: generatedAssertion
records.question: کدام خروجی ProvenanceActivity در منبع تولید Assertion را اثبات می‌کند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: A ProvenanceActivity output trace names the Assertion.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Reading an Assertion does not mean the activity generated it.

records.name: hasActiveSubstance
records.question: آیا subject عام Product/Presentation باید در دو زیررابطهٔ نوع‌دار جدا شود؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Keep broad parent; mapping-specific Product M016 and optional Presentation child require separate scope evidence.
records.evidence_to_collect: Keep parent domain open; test separate Product and Presentation scoped patterns and composition cardinalities.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not infer that a presentation using the parent relation is a MedicinalProduct; these Kinds are disjoint.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep the broad parent property. Add a Product-specific child for evidenced M016 mappings and a Presentation-specific child only when a source explicitly supports it.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: hasDatasetRelease
records.question: معیار تعلق یک DatasetRelease به Dataset در میان نسخه‌ها چیست؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Release lineage names a Dataset and its DatasetRelease.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Equal publication dates do not merge releases.

records.name: hasDosageForm
records.question: آیا هر Presentation الزاماً DosageFormSpecification واحدی دارد یا ویژگی منبع ناقص است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Formal specification reference; optional/mandatory at conceptual level requires scientific decision.
records.evidence_to_collect: Presentation specification refers to DosageFormSpecification.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A generic Product dosage label does not identify this Presentation's form.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep a formal reference to DosageFormSpecification. Defer global minimum and maximum cardinalities until Presentation identity and source completeness are evaluated.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: hasMatchConfidence
records.question: آیا MatchConfidence برای هر EntityMatchAssertion الزامی و یکتا است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Bearer→Quality Characterization only if conceptual totality/uniqueness is accepted; missing scores may be source incompleteness.
records.evidence_to_collect: MatchConfidence is an intrinsic Quality of one EntityMatchAssertion; totality remains unresolved.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: One Quality individual cannot belong to two distinct Assertions.
records.approved_decision_en: Treat MatchConfidence as a Quality dependent on one EntityMatchAssertion, but hold class-wide Characterization and the minimum-one constraint until unscored assertions are resolved. Record this as an open conformance blocker.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: hasPackageConfiguration
records.question: آیا هر Presentation یک PackageConfiguration دارد و specification از شیء فیزیکی جداست؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Formal specification reference; packaging value does not imply physical part relation.
records.evidence_to_collect: Presentation specification references PackageConfiguration.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A pack-size value is insufficient to identify a configuration.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep a reference to PackageConfiguration as a specification. Do not use componentOf or a universal existence constraint until identity and completeness are established.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: hasStrength
records.question: آیا هر Presentation دست‌کم یک Strength دارد و آیا Strength فقط یک bearer دارد؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Align OWL/SHACL in separate candidate only after documenting whether every Presentation has Strength; test uniqueness and incompleteness.
records.evidence_to_collect: W4 says Strength is the Quality characterizing ProductPresentation.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: One Strength individual cannot belong to two distinct Presentations.
records.candidate_change_authorized: Only bounded engineering candidate; no promotion

records.name: listingJurisdiction
records.question: Scope قانونی MarketListing از چه شاهدی فراتر از country/address به دست می‌آید؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain contextual reference; collect legal-scope evidence; no Relator→rigid Mediation
records.evidence_to_collect: Listing validity by scope, source authority and temporal closure; if mediation is proposed, justify a distinct anti-rigid jurisdiction Role and its lifecycle.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Presence of P in a national source or the labeler's address alone cannot create a market listing for J.

records.name: locatedIn
records.question: آیا parent عمومی فقط spatial reference می‌ماند و Facility-specific edge صرفاً در نگاشت M031 اعمال شود؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Preserve generic parent until all locatable entity families reviewed; use a scoped facility location contract.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An organization's headquarters or a jurisdiction label must not be typed Facility via a global domain axiom.

records.name: maintainsDataset
records.question: آیا stewardship نسبت به Dataset در طول زمان عوض می‌شود و چه مرجعی آن را ثابت می‌کند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Stewardship evidence identifies a DataSourceResource maintaining Dataset.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Hosting a copy does not prove maintenance.

records.name: matchObject
records.question: subject/object تطبیق به entity یا representation اشاره می‌کنند و خانوادهٔ هویتی target چیست؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Define whether subject/object are SourceRecord or a typed union, symmetrical admissibility, cardinality and identity constraints.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An ambiguous record pair is not an accepted real-world identity equality.

records.name: matchSubject
records.question: subject/object تطبیق به entity یا representation اشاره می‌کنند و خانوادهٔ هویتی target چیست؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Define a common endpoint policy with matchObject, disjoint source-vs-entity layers and acceptable null/ambiguous status.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A source identifier alone is not universal canonical entity identity.

records.name: observationAboutPresentation
records.question: آیا result با سند مشخص دربارهٔ Presentation است، بی‌آنکه همهٔ resultها Presentation شوند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain child untyped until parent truthmaker and target family are justified
records.evidence_to_collect: Specify reference identity, exactness of source key, derivation of aboutness, admissible absence, parent semantics and end multiplicity.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A product-level code alone cannot be silently promoted to a particular presentation or patient observation.

records.name: observationAboutProduct
records.question: آیا result با سند مشخص دربارهٔ Product است، بی‌آنکه همهٔ resultها Product شوند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain child untyped until parent truthmaker and target family are justified
records.evidence_to_collect: Specify product identity evidence, source scope, derivation of aboutness, parent semantics and end multiplicity.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A result keyed to only one package does not thereby describe every presentation or the product in all jurisdictions.

records.name: observationResultAbout
records.question: خانوادهٔ target عمومی result چیست و آیا به pattern موضوعات نوع‌دار نیاز داریم؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Test all result subfamilies before a common range; preserve child target distinctions and resolve aboutness truthmaker.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An aggregate result does not create a patient individual, and a product link does not identify a presentation.

records.name: operates
records.question: آیا قاعدهٔ اشتقاق از همان FacilityOperation با بازهٔ اعتبار و provenance برای material relation پذیرفته است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Specify executable same-relator temporal/provenance rule outside bare OWL annotation; test false cross-joins and time boundaries.
records.evidence_to_collect: FacilityOperation relator mediates OperatingOrganizationRole and OperatedFacilityRole; both specialize Organization and Facility.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An Organization and Facility co-occurring in a source record without FacilityOperation must not yield operates.
records.candidate_change_authorized: Only bounded engineering candidate; no promotion

records.name: presentationOf
records.question: آیا هر Presentation دقیقاً به یک Product تعریف‌شده تعلق دارد و تغییر Product هویت آن را عوض می‌کند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Formal Presentation→Product identity association; reject Product/Presentation mereology.
records.evidence_to_collect: Product definition explicitly identifies the Presentation's Product.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A Product source row alone does not instantiate a Presentation.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep presentationOf as a formal Presentation-to-Product association. Examine the one-Product identity condition in the candidate, but defer a universal OWL cardinality until author review.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: producesObservationResult
records.question: کدام provenance ارتباط رویداد ObservationActivity و Result را اثبات می‌کند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Provenance links an ObservationActivity to its generated Result.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: An imported aggregate result does not entail a particular event.

records.name: registrationJurisdiction
records.question: ثبت در کدام scope قانونی معتبر است و آیا به نقش jurisdictional جداگانه نیاز داریم؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain contextual reference; collect legal-scope evidence; no Relator→rigid Mediation
records.evidence_to_collect: Source-backed scope, validity interval and distinct legal-versus-geographic identifiers; review an anti-rigid scope Role only if dependence evidence warrants it.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: The facility's geographic position alone cannot infer a registration in J.

records.name: reimbursementDiagnosisContext
records.question: کد/نسخهٔ DiagnosisClassificationReference در aggregate result چگونه ثبت می‌شود؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Aggregate source references a versioned DiagnosisClassificationReference.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Counts do not instantiate patients or diagnoses.

records.name: riskAssessmentConcerns
records.question: موضوع RiskAssessmentActivity باید Asset/Dependency/Event/Plan باشد یا یک target عام مستند؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Admit target families with assessment evidence; do not impose a deferred AssetAtRisk range.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Mentioning an asset does not prove a vulnerability or quantified risk.

records.name: riskAssessmentConcernsDependency
records.question: آیا child edge فقط با ارزیابی مستند SupplyDependency ایجاد می‌شود؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain child untyped until parent truthmaker and target family are justified
records.evidence_to_collect: Define topic admission, assessment evidence and time, parent semantics, endpoint identity and multiplicities.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Mentioning S in a document or observing a disruption does not prove a quantified risk or vulnerability of S.

records.name: riskTreatmentAddresses
records.question: موضوع RiskTreatmentActivity به کدام target با شواهد برنامه و اجرا وصل است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Define treatment plan/target semantics, evidence and direction before adding range or stereotype.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Do not claim that every treatment is effective, or that a target is necessarily a SupplyDependency.

records.name: shortageJurisdiction
records.question: Jurisdiction نسبت به shortage از source status و بازهٔ زمانی چگونه تعیین می‌شود؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Source identifies a jurisdictionally bounded ShortageSituation.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A J1 shortage does not imply a J2 shortage.

records.name: shortagePresentation
records.question: آیا Product-level shortage بدون سند package اجازهٔ Presentation-level edge می‌دهد؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Require source-backed presentation specificity; Product-level shortage alone is insufficient.
records.evidence_to_collect: Source identifies a particular presentation in a shortage.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Product-only report does not identify a package/presentation.
records.approved_decision_en: Create shortagePresentation only when a source identifies the exact Presentation, period and jurisdiction. Do not derive it from a Product-only report.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: shortageProduct
records.question: آیا Presentation-level shortage همهٔ Product را درگیر می‌کند یا به scope منبع محدود است؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Scope shortage to evidenced Product, not all presentations.
records.evidence_to_collect: Source identifies the Product concerned by shortage.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Presentation shortage does not establish shortage of all presentations.
records.approved_decision_en: Record shortageProduct only with an identified Product and report scope; do not infer shortages for all of its Presentations.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: usedSourceArtifact
records.question: آیا ProvenanceActivity از Dataset/Record/Artifact استفاده کرده و target family چیست؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Retain current broad or untyped relation; gather source-specific witnesses before any global axiom
records.evidence_to_collect: Specify the admitted source-artifact abstraction or scoped subproperties for record/release/document; check PROV alignment.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: A dataset name alone cannot fabricate a source record or complete provenance chain.

records.name: withinCountry
records.question: آیا containment اداری versioned است و آیا هر GeographicFeature دقیقاً یک Country دارد؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Use versioned spatial/administrative reference; avoid componentOf and blanket one-Country axiom.
records.evidence_to_collect: Geographic reference establishes feature containment in Country.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Country cannot be within itself; Jurisdiction is distinct.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep withinCountry as a versioned formal spatial or administrative reference; prohibit self-containment and limit an exactly-one-Country constraint to proven data scope.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending

records.name: withinRegion
records.question: آیا containment اداری versioned است و آیا هر GeographicFeature دقیقاً یک Region دارد؟
records.preferred_bounded_action: Use versioned spatial/administrative reference; avoid componentOf and blanket one-Region axiom.
records.evidence_to_collect: Geographic reference establishes feature containment in AdministrativeRegion.
records.negative_acceptance_condition: Region cannot be within itself or inferred from postal label.
records.approved_decision_en: Keep a versioned formal administrative or spatial reference; reject self-containment and postal-label inference, and scope any exactly-one-Region rule to complete sources.
records.approval_conditions: Scoped/conditional; formal validation and instance evidence still pending
